Audit a Quarto, RMarkdown, or LaTeX manuscript against saved R model objects

Source: R/audit-manuscript.R
audit_manuscript.Rd

Parses inline prose and Markdown/LaTeX tables in .qmd, .Rmd, .md, or .tex manuscripts—covering point estimates, standard errors, p-values, confidence intervals, test statistics (t, z, F, chi2, r), odds ratios (OR), sample sizes (N), \(R^2\), and AIC/BIC—and cross-checks them against fitted R model objects (lm, glm, lmerMod, htest, or tidy summary data frames). Also performs internal arithmetic cross-checking (verifying that reported t/z matches b / SE and that reported 95% CI bounds are consistent with b and SE up to rounding intervals), which works even for untagged claims or when models = NULL.

Usage

audit_manuscript(
  manuscript,
  models = NULL,
  tol_extra = 0,
  warn_rounding = TRUE,
  default_model = NULL,
  check_internal = TRUE
)

Arguments

manuscript

Path to a .qmd, .Rmd, .md, or .tex file.

models

Optional saved models to cross-check against. One of:

  • A named list of fitted model objects (lm, glm, lmerMod, htest) or tidy summary data frames;

  • A single fitted model object or tidy summary data frame;

  • Path to an .rds file containing a model or named list of models;

  • Path to a directory containing .rds model files (keyed by filename stem);

  • NULL to run internal arithmetic consistency checks only.

tol_extra

Non-negative numeric extra tolerance added on top of the automatic rounding half-unit (0.5 * 10^(-decimals)). Default 0.

warn_rounding

Logical; if TRUE (default), values off by at most one unit in the last reported decimal place are flagged as "warn" (rounding_discrepancy) rather than "fail".

default_model

Optional default model name used for untagged claims when multiple models are provided.

check_internal

Logical; if TRUE (default), run interval-arithmetic internal consistency checks (t vs b / SE, 95% CI midpoint & width vs b and SE) on every claim group and table row.

Value

An S3 object of class "statci_manuscript_audit" containing checks (model comparison tibble::tibble), internal_checks (internal arithmetic tibble::tibble), summary, manuscript, models_checked, and overall status ("pass", "warn", or "fail").

Details

Supports explicit annotations for zero-ambiguity binding:

  • HTML comment anchors: <!-- statci: model=fit1 term=x1 -->

  • LaTeX comment anchors: % statci: model=fit1 term=x1

  • Quarto inline spans: [b = 0.42, SE = 0.11, p = .003]{.statci model="fit1" term="x1"}

Examples

fit <- lm(mpg ~ wt, data = mtcars)
txt <- paste0(
  "<!-- statci: model=fit term=wt -->\n",
  "Weight predicted MPG (b = ", round(coef(fit)["wt"], 2),
  ", N = ", nobs(fit), ").\n"
)
audit_manuscript_text(txt, models = list(fit = fit))
#> [PASS] statci Manuscript Audit (<text>): 2 claim(s) | 2 pass, 0 warn, 0 fail
